notes.title: Free shooter Straftat gets a 2v2 update and if my maths are correct this makes it twice as intense 1v1
notes.notes:
You already knew hectic 1v1 bullet sprayer Straftat was going to add 2v2 matches and a four-player free-for-all mode. You knew because I told you months ago. Don't pretend you forgot. notes.title: 2v2/FFA MASSIVE UPDATE
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone !


We’re happy to launch today the official 4 Players STRAFTAT update FOR FREE. It includes both 2v2 and Free For All (1v1v1v1). Team matches can be 1v2 and 1v3 as well. 

This was by far the most requested feature for the game since release back in october. We hope these new gamemodes will meet your expectations. Thanks for your patience.




-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
NEW FEATURES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 New Gamemodes : Teams, FFA (both : up to 4 players)

New lobby settings (Friendly fire, mid match joining, player outline)

Reworked and improved Main Menu interface

Lots of improvements on Logs in killfeed

Added 4 Player Spawn Points to each map

Weapon Randomizer Improvements (Customize weapon pool, spawn rate…)

Native Map Playlists

Added Speedometer (Enable in Graphics Options)

Map Playlists export/import (easy to share your playlists online)

Killcam improvements

New trailer for DLC 

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
NEW DLC
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

STRAFTAT : Supporter Edition (9.99$)

This DLC unlocks : 

Exclusive suits

Exclusive hats

Artbook PDF

Download link to blender files containing environment scenes. 

By purchasing this DLC you help us fund the development of our next game (Babbdi2), as we will need external help from a freelance sound designer, animator, and more!

This helps us grow as a studio and speeds up the development.

Thank you <3

valhalla_03, valhalla_04, valhalla_05

notes.title: The best FPS of 2024 simply cannot stop adding new maps, introducing 37 new arenas, 4 new weapons, and a 'Horrible Smelly Head' in its latest update
notes.notes:
Rarely have I been so instantly enamoured with a game as Straftat, a gleefully chaotic micro-FPS created by two brothers who couldn't find a decent deathmatch shooter to play. Straftat pitches two players against each other in lightning-paced 1v1 duels. Less of a throwback and more of a distillation of the classic deathmatches of yore—particularly Half-Life with shades of Quake and Unreal in there too—it features dozens of weapons, 150 small yet wildly inventive maps, and a wonderful selection of hats, all for the low, low price of nothing...
                Read more.

notes.title: The best FPS of 2024 just got a surprise free update with 30 new maps, 9 new weapons, and just one cheeky cosmetic
notes.notes:
STRAFTAT, the winner of our Best FPS of 2024 award, has just come out with a beefy free update that consists of 30 new maps (plus three more for DLC-owning players), nine new weapons, new features and QoL tweaks, as well as a lone new suit for the arena shooter's delightfully ugly little potato men...
                Read more.

notes.title: JANUARY FREE UPDATE
notes.notes:
This update adds a lot of new content, including new maps, new weapons and new features. Thank you for your patience as we continue to work on the game and improve it !

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
NEW MAPS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This update adds 30 free maps to the game as well as 3 DLC maps.
Here is a list of the new maps included in the base game : 

 TheSamePlace (a total of 15 maps)
 Stroke (a total of 2 maps)
 StLucia (a total of 5 maps)
 ReeperBahn (a total of 2 maps)
 Patio_00
 HighWall_00
 LostCity_00
 Adread_00
 EndGame
 Canliferous_map

The new DLC maps are : 

 Chateaux_13_Alt_Alt
 LostCity_00_Alt
 StLucia_00_Alt
 More alt maps coming soon

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
NEW WEAPONS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 9 New Weapons added to the game, that can mostly be found in the new maps listed above. 
Including : 

 AP Mine
 Bukanee
 Hill H15
 FG42
 HK Caws
 HK G11
 QCW05
 Webley
 New Melee Weapon : The Katana

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
NEW FEATURES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Added an active playlist system. The active playlist is always automatically loaded when you host a lobby, even after restarting the game. Your active playlist can be set in the maps menu.
 Added rematch voting at the end of a game. Both players need to vote in order to rematch.
 Added a tutorial map for beginners or newbies
 Added the ability to rebind your Right Fire and Left Fire keys.
 New Lobby Renaming feature
 Added one new DLC suit
 Added three new taunts (keys 4, 5 and 6)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FIXES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Your first person arms now show the correct skin (instead of always the default one)
 Fixed reload rebinding
 Ladders can now be shot through
 Improved mouse sensitivity sliders (you can now lower your sensitivity down to 0.005)
 Nerfed phoenix
 You can't look around anymore when you are tased
